SLSTR L1B reader returns wrong radiance/reflectance values for products with new baseline collection 005

@simon-sat 

**Describe the bug**
The current SLSTR L1B reader (slstr_l1b) applies automatically channel adjustment factors to compensate well known calibration bias in SLSTR L1B products. Recently, the SLSTR L1B products are delivered under a new baseline collection 005, which includes a correction of this bias. It means that using the current satpy reader with this new baseline is actually doing the correction twice.

- Adjustment factors in current satpy reader: https://github.com/pytroll/satpy/blob/main/satpy/readers/slstr_l1b.py#L46
- Description of the baseline collection 005: https://user.eumetsat.int/news-events/news/new-processing-baseline-for-sentinel-3-slstr-l1

Read any recent SLSTR L1B product (with baseline collection 005). The channels that are the most impacted are the ones with the highest adjustments factors (S5 and S6)

**Expected behavior**
The reader detects the baseline collection, and if higher or equal to 005, the internal calibration adjustment is disabled.
